summary_1line: Dhritarashtra questions Sanjaya about Drona’s furious night assault after Jayadratha’s death, as Drona devastates the Pandava forces in the chaotic darkness.

image_candidates.scene_text: In pitch darkness, warriors clash while their golden armor and weapons glow like scattered stars across a blood-soaked battlefield.
Owls perch on Kaurava standards and jackals howl as elephants, chariots, and soldiers fight blindly in the night.
Drona stands in his chariot unleashing arrows in every direction, cutting down elephants and warriors amid a storm-like battlefield.
